name: Zerah
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy

points: Zerah the Ethiopian, a Cushite, comes out with a host of a thousand thousand and three hundred chariots. Asa cries unto the Most High that it is nothing for him to help with many or with them that have no power.

note.label: 2 Chronicles 14: Asa Seeks the Most High and Finds Rest
